source_snapshot.procedure: Confirm the SUT recipe, clear logs, prepare the system specification and motherboard, check jumper location on the motherboard, then collect results/photos and unexpected logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Make sure jumper location is correct
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: The jumper location audit is a human-only visual inspection; the operator photographs each location.

original_test_intent.purpose: Audit the physical motherboard location of every specified jumper and verify that each observed reference designator/position matches the exact board-revision drawing and system specification, without changing jumper state.
original_test_intent.target: One positively identified motherboard/planar revision and the complete owner-approved jumper-location inventory for that revision; not a generic board image or the logical setting of a jumper.
original_test_intent.scope: A full manual location-only inspection of all listed jumper reference designators, including traceable photos and observed-versus-expected mapping. Moving, bridging or functionally testing a jumper is outside scope.
original_test_intent.operation: Place the board in the approved powered-off/discharged ESD-safe state, confirm revision and drawing, expose the board without touching jumpers, locate and photograph every checklist reference with orientation context, record missing/extra/mismatched labels or positions, restore the chassis and verify that nothing moved.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One complete pass over the owner-approved jumper inventory; the source lists five attended and five machine minutes but completeness is defined by reference-designator coverage, not elapsed time.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Every required jumper reference is present at the exact documented board location and orientation context, every observation is traceable to the correct board revision, no jumper is moved, and the board/chassis is safely restored.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Board/planar identity and revision, authoritative drawing/version, complete jumper inventory, per-reference expected and observed coordinates/landmarks, timestamped overview/detail photos, mismatch notes, no-movement attestation, chassis restoration and supporting health evidence.
ambiguities: The source provides no board revision, reference-designator inventory, drawing/version, coordinate/landmark convention or required photo coverage.
The source phrase 'correct location' does not define whether an unpopulated jumper footprint is expected and must be distinguished from a missing installed shunt.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly distinguishes a physical location audit from jumper-state/function testing, requires the exact board revision/drawing and full inventory, prohibits movement, uses powered-off/ESD controls, preserves logs and requires per-jumper photos.

applicable_history.decision: The historical one-by-one review retained physical/manual execution and operator evidence for the jumper location check.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: V2's technical conclusion is already correct. This is a location-only physical audit with no jumper movement or functional stimulus; the agent may prepare the map and evidence package but cannot infer board location from software.

available_now: The source clearly limits the requested fact to physical jumper location on the motherboard.
Board identity and supporting system/BMC baselines can be collected read-only before physical access, without clearing logs.
missing_inputs: Exact motherboard/planar identity and revision plus the authoritative layout/assembly drawing version
Complete expected jumper reference-designator list, including populated versus unpopulated footprints and location/orientation landmarks
Qualified operator, approved chassis/power-discharge/ESD access procedure, lighting/camera and per-reference photo/evidence convention
Owner process for mislabeled, missing, obstructed, damaged or mismatched hardware and final disposition
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The motherboard/platform owner supplies the revision-specific drawing and jumper inventory; the lab owner supplies safe physical access, operator and imaging; the hardware owner resolves drawing/board mismatches.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect platform and board revision identity and prepare the expected-versus-observed checklist without asserting physical location
Preserve current host/BMC/SEL evidence and verify evidence storage/provenance without clearing logs
prohibited_until_closed: Do not open or touch the board without safe power/ESD controls; do not move, remove, bridge, rotate or correct any jumper under this testcase
Do not use a drawing from another revision, infer physical location from BIOS/software state, clear logs, or mark an obstructed/unphotographed reference as verified
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Board and drawing revisions match; the expected inventory explicitly covers populated/unpopulated references; operator/access/photo plan is approved; every reference receives traceable evidence; no-movement and safe-restoration checks are complete.

revision_candidate.purpose: Verify that every specified motherboard jumper reference is physically located where the exact board-revision drawing defines it, without changing any jumper position or state.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact motherboard/planar revision in a powered-off/discharged, ESD-controlled service environment with the matching owner-approved drawing and complete jumper inventory.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All reference designators in the approved location checklist, including specified populated or unpopulated footprints. Configuration state, electrical function and correction are outside scope.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Board identity/revision; drawing/version; complete jumper reference list with population expectation and landmarks; safe access/ESD procedure; qualified operator; lighting/photo/evidence convention; mismatch owner and separate correction process.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: No software command proves physical location. Confirm the board/drawing revision, safely expose the board, visually locate each checklist reference without touching it, capture overview and readable detail photos with orientation, record expected versus observed location/population, close the chassis and attest that no jumper moved.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Board/drawing/inventory matched; safe power discharge and ESD controls active; access and imaging adequate; evidence path ready; operator authorized; mismatch escalation and restoration defined; logs preserved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Board/drawing identities; signed complete checklist; per-reference expected/observed location and population; timestamped overview/detail photos with orientation; mismatch/obstruction notes; no-movement attestation; restored chassis and supporting unchanged health evidence.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The motherboard/platform owner's exact revision-controlled layout/assembly drawing and approved jumper-location/population list.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never move or bridge a jumper, touch board components unnecessarily, inspect an energized board when disallowed, use a mismatched drawing, clear logs, infer location from software or make corrective changes in this audit.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: A qualified operator performs and attests the visual inspection. The board owner resolves any drawing, label, population or location discrepancy and approves separate correction if needed.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Physical access, reference identification, visual comparison and photos are manual. The agent may prepare the matrix, validate file provenance and collect supporting read-only health evidence, but cannot claim first-hand location verification.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: If the board/drawing mismatches or a jumper is missing, damaged or misplaced, stop and preserve the as-found evidence, leave all hardware unchanged, close the chassis safely and use a separate owner-approved correction and health-verification procedure.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unknown or mismatched board revision, incomplete inventory, ambiguous/population-undefined reference, obstructed or unsafe view, inadequate ESD/power state, request to move hardware, damaged/missing label, untraceable photo, evidence loss or inability to restore the chassis safely.

identified_defects: The source omits the board revision, controlled drawing and complete expected jumper inventory.
The source's log-clearing step is unnecessary and would remove supporting history.
The source does not distinguish an expected unpopulated jumper footprint from a missing shunt.
reason_for_change: No material V2 correction is warranted. V3 preserves its location-only/manual boundary and formalizes population expectation, drawing ownership, completeness and no-movement closure.

new_technical_evidence.title: Functionality one-by-one review
new_technical_evidence.supports: The historical review independently retained physical/manual execution for this jumper location audit.

removed_ambiguities: Separates physical location and population evidence from logical jumper state or function.
Defines completion by coverage of every revision-specific reference designator rather than time.
remaining_blockers: Physical execution waits for the exact board/drawing/inventory, safe ESD/power access, qualified operator and mismatch disposition process.
objective_improvement_over_v2: No material technical conclusion changes because V2 is already correct. V3 adds an auditable populated-versus-unpopulated inventory rule and explicit completeness/restoration criteria without expanding the test into jumper movement or function.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The high-risk manual physical contract is queued for later isolated validation.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The source asks for each motherboard jumper location to be checked against the system specification and motherboard.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 already distinguishes location from state/function and prohibits all movement; V3 retains it.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Inspection requires the exact revision drawing, safe powered-off/ESD access and per-reference photos; no jumper may be moved or corrected within this case.
